source_text: Medicalization trends have emerged, with procedures shifting from traditional practitioners to health workers in nations like Kenya (up to 20% of cases by 2022) and Egypt (15% increase since 2014), potentially reducing immediate complications but perpetuating the practice under a veneer of legitimacy.
